candidate_gaps.description: Unconfirmed static candidate. mincore: Stub implementation. The sandbox does not have access to this information. Reports all mapped pages are resident. Arguments and runtime configuration matter; a reference alone is not an incompatibility.

Unconfirmed static candidate. madvise: Options MADV_DONTNEED, MADV_DONTFORK are supported. Other advice is ignored. Arguments and runtime configuration matter; a reference alone is not an incompatibility.
Unconfirmed static candidate. futex: Robust futexes not supported. Arguments and runtime configuration matter; a reference alone is not an incompatibility.
Unconfirmed static candidate. clone: Options CLONE_NEWTIME and CLONE_SYSVSEM not supported. Arguments and runtime configuration matter; a reference alone is not an incompatibility.
Unconfirmed static candidate. arch_prctl: Options ARCH_GET_GS, ARCH_SET_GS not supported. Arguments and runtime configuration matter; a reference alone is not an incompatibility.
Unconfirmed static candidate. sched_getaffinity: Stub implementation. Arguments and runtime configuration matter; a reference alone is not an incompatibility.
Unconfirmed static candidate. In-sandbox cgroup accounting does not imply enforcement of limits between processes in the same sandbox. Host cgroups can still limit the sandbox as a whole.

capability_set.interpretation: Upper-bound capability candidates for analyzed code only. This is not an exhaustive syscall set or a compatibility verdict; indirect/dynamic dispatch and untested paths remain unknown.

limitations: Results cover only the declared profile and environment; absence of a finding is not proof of compatibility.
Static resolution does not establish reachability, syscall arguments, or a complete capability upper bound for dynamically generated code.
Output comparisons require deterministic profile assertions; unobserved filesystem, cgroup, and networking semantics remain unknown.
Elapsed-time comparisons include unequal tracer/runtime startup overhead and do not establish a netstack/gofer root cause.
